title: The 2026 Audubon Photography Awards
text:
Gail Bisson / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Common Merganser . Winner, Female Bird, U.S. and Canada. East Bay Sandbar, Nova Scotia, Canada.

 Timothy Dhalleine / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Crested Caracara . Winner, Birds in Landscapes, Chile and Colombia. Torres del Paine National Park, Magallanes and Chilean Antarctic region, Chile.

 Camilo Sanabria Grajales / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Ruby-Topaz Hummingbird . Honorable Mention, Youth, Chile and Colombia. Guadalajara de Buga, Valle del Cauca, Colombia.

 Jacqueline Burke / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Roseate Spoonbill . Grand-Prize Winner, U.S. and Canada. St. Augustine Alligator Farm Zoological Park, St. Augustine, Florida.

 Liron Gertsman / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 White-Tailed Tropicbird . Winner, Birds in Landscapes, U.S. and Canada. Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park, Volcano, Hawaiʻi.

 Mike Henry / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Gila Woodpecker and Saguaro Cactus . Winner, Plants for Birds, U.S. and Canada. Tucson, Arizona.

 Jay Vanos / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Great Blue Heron . Honorable Mention, Birds in Landscapes, U.S. and Canada. Caddo Lake Wildlife Management Area, Karnak, Texas.

 Faber Mosquera Alvarez / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Oilbird . Winner, Birds in Landscapes, Chile and Colombia. Pijao, Quindío, Colombia, in the Cañón de los Guácharos.

 Rodrigo González Pairoa / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Black-Browed Albatross . Winner, Birds Without Borders, Chile and Colombia. Almirantazgo Fjord, Chile.

 Nick Parayko / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Tennessee Warbler . Winner, Birds Without Borders, U.S. and Canada. St. Albert, Alberta, Canada (in the photographer’s backyard).

 Paulo Olivier Hanshing / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Neotropic Cormorant . Honorable Mention, Birds in Landscapes, Chile and Colombia. Near Caleta Talcaruca, Limarí, Coquimbo Region, Chile.

 Francisco Castro Escobar / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Lesser Horned Owl . Grand-Prize Winner, Chile and Colombia. Antofagasta, Chile.

 Rubén Barraza / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Spectacled Tyrant . Honorable Mention, Birds Without Borders, Chile and Colombia. Elqui River Wetland, La Serena, Coquimbo Region, Chile.

 Erich Podbielski / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Brown Pelican . Honorable Mention, Birds Without Borders, U.S. and Canada. Haystack Rock, Cannon Beach, Oregon.

 Juan David Camacho Márquez / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Canada Warbler , Winner, Youth, Chile and Colombia. Doña Dora Birding, El Queremal, Valle del Cauca, Colombia.

 Kevin Lohman / 2026 Audubon Photography Awards

 Brandt’s Cormorant and Surfgrass . Honorable Mention, Plants for Birds, U.S. and Canada. Natural Bridges State Beach, Santa Cruz, California.

 To see all of this year’s winners, be sure to visit Audubon’s awards website .
